# Requirements Quality Checklist: Merlin Assembler Dialect

**Purpose**: Validate that spec 019's own requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before planning begins. These items test the *writing*, not the implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

**Focus areas**: the dialect mechanism, the Merlin subset boundary, the corpus oracle, diagnostics.
**Depth**: release gate, 019 blocks `023-ca65-dialect`, so a requirements defect here propagates.
**Audience**: reviewer, before `/speckit-plan`.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the requirements for selecting a dialect separated from the requirements for selecting a CPU? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Is every Merlin construct the feature claims to support covered by a named requirement rather than only by prose? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007..§FR-015, §FR-027]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for constructs the feature deliberately refuses, with the reason for each refusal? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, §FR-028, §FR-029]
- [x] CHK004 Does the spec state where reference bytes come from, rather than assuming an oracle exists? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for reporting which dialect was applied when none was stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for the dialect an in-process entry point uses when its caller names none? FR-006 requires selection be *available* everywhere but never states the default. [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements defined for what the assembler produces when a subset-boundary refusal fires, no output at all, or a partial image? FR-018 requires every offending construct be reported but is silent on output. [Gap, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements defined for symbol case sensitivity under Merlin? The assembler already carries a case-sensitivity option, and the spec never says what Merlin's rule is. [Gap]
- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements defined for Merlin's symbol length limit and legal label character set? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK010 Are requirements defined for what happens when a directive names an output that cannot be written? [Gap, Spec §FR-027]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK011 Is "column rules" resolved into a specific line model rather than left to interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK012 Is the treatment of tabs stated explicitly rather than deferred to implementation? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Is "discoverable" defined as a specific stream and condition rather than as an unqualified adjective? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK014 Is "one place that both the implementation and the documentation derive from" resolved into a specific mechanism? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK015 Is the word "representative" replaced by an enumerated minimum? [Clarity, Spec §Corpus Floor, §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK016 Is "the vocabulary of the active dialect" defined well enough that two reviewers would agree whether a given diagnostic complies? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK017 Is "strictly and authentically" defined for the *existing* AS65 profile, specifically, whether AS65 may begin rejecting source it accepts today? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK018 Is FR-023's "behave as they do today or have their change documented" measurable, or does it permit any change so long as something is written down? [Measurability, Spec §FR-023]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK019 Do the Overview's statements about the CPU axis agree with FR-002 and FR-026, rather than promising a CPU flag under every dialect? [Consistency, Spec §Overview, §FR-002, §FR-026]
- [x] CHK020 Do FR-015 and FR-016 agree about which occurrence of the CPU-selection directive each one owns? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK021 Does the Overview's claim that the object-file directive can be honored without 020 have a matching requirement? [Consistency, Spec §Overview, §FR-027]
- [x] CHK022 Are the three deferred file-related directives given distinct reasons rather than a single shared one that misattributes the blocker? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027, §FR-028, §FR-029]
- [x] CHK023 Does the diagnostic-position requirement stay consistent with the success criterion that AS65 output bytes are unchanged? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK024 Is the requirement-numbering discontinuity explained, so a reader does not read it as an editing error? [Consistency, Spec §Functional Requirements]
- [x] CHK025 Do FR-005 (strict, authentic dialects) and FR-023 (existing invocations keep working) conflict where today's AS65 leniency is the documented behavior? [Conflict, Spec §FR-005, §FR-023]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK026 Can SC-001 be evaluated without running another assembler at test time? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK027 Is the criterion measuring the dialect *mechanism* distinct from the criteria measuring Merlin, so 023 has something to gate on? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK028 Does the mechanism criterion specify how the claim is demonstrated rather than merely asserted? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK029 Is the corpus floor written so that "done" is countable rather than a judgment call? [Measurability, Spec §Corpus Floor]
- [ ] CHK030 Is SC-003 ("every rejection of valid Merlin source is a reported defect") falsifiable, given the corpus is the only definition of "valid Merlin source" the project has? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK031 Is SC-008 ("determine subset membership from the documentation alone") measurable, or does it depend on an unstated reader? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK032 Are requirements defined for the primary flow, unmodified Merlin source assembling to matching bytes? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1]
- [x] CHK033 Are requirements defined for the exception flow where a construct falls outside the supported subset? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-016..§FR-019]
- [x] CHK034 Are requirements defined for multi-file assembly, including which file a diagnostic names? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, §FR-025]
- [x] CHK035 Does the corpus floor require a negative class, so refusal and diagnostic expectations are covered rather than only successful assembly? [Coverage, Spec §Corpus Floor]
- [ ] CHK036 Are requirements defined for recovery after a subset-boundary refusal, whether the developer is told what to change, or only what is unsupported? [Gap, Recovery Flow, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK037 Are requirements defined for source that mixes an accepted construct with a refused one in the same assembly? [Coverage, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK038 Are requirements defined for the character whose meaning differs across dialects? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK039 Are requirements defined for a directive spelling that collides with an instruction mnemonic? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK040 Is the unverified question about resetting the CPU target recorded as something to settle by capture rather than silently assumed? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK041 Are requirements defined for an unterminated dummy section, loop, or macro at end of file? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-011, §FR-012, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK042 Are requirements defined for nesting limits on the loop construct, macros, and file inclusion, and for a file that includes itself? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-011, §FR-013, §FR-014]
- [x] CHK043 Is the mixed-dialect inclusion edge case actionable, given a dialect is not something an included file declares? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK044 Are test-isolation constraints reflected in the requirements rather than left for the plan to discover? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK045 Is the constraint that the tool's standard output stays clean for piping stated as a requirement? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK046 Are performance expectations stated for dialect dispatch, or is the constitution's general responsiveness bar assumed to carry? [Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK047 Is the dependency on Casso's own emulation bounded in time, so a reader knows tests do not depend on it? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK048 Is the choice of oracle version justified, rather than left to whichever Merlin is convenient? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK049 Is the licensing constraint on the oracle's disk image stated, along with what may be committed instead? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK050 Is the 020 relationship characterized accurately per directive, convenience for capture, blocker for file types, and neither for save-object? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-028, §FR-029]
- [x] CHK051 Is the assumption that the shared engine, evaluator, and opcode tables need no dialect-specific change stated and testable? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK052 Is the assumption that Merlin's expression operators and precedence match the existing evaluator stated as an assumption to be tested, rather than left implicit? [Assumption, Spec §Corpus Floor]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- Unchecked items are genuine gaps in the *requirements*, not known implementation defects.
- CHK025 and CHK043 were closed by amending the spec: FR-005 now scopes "authentic" for AS65 to today's behavior, and the mixed-dialect edge case now resolves to explained parse failure rather than ahead-of-time detection.
- The remaining 14 are limits, lifecycles, and definitions that want a technical answer. They are inputs to `/speckit-plan`, and any that the plan cannot settle should come back here as a spec amendment rather than being decided during implementation.
